title: Comfort, and a Long Quiet
paragraphs: At last some of the people came home. The temple was rebuilt, though it wasn't as grand. Then came a long quiet. The prophets stopped speaking for a very long time, and the people waited. "Comfort, comfort my people," Isaiah had said, and spoke of a voice calling, "Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness!" Malachi said a messenger would come, and that the sun of righteousness would rise "with healing in its wings" (WEB). Waiting is hard. Perhaps you are waiting for something now. But in the quiet, God was still at work, getting the world ready. The silence was not an ending. It was a held breath.
wonder: I wonder what is easier to hear in a long quiet?
activity: Sit in total silence for one minute, together, and then say what you noticed.
prayer: God of patient love, help us to wait well, and trust that you are working even when we cannot see. Amen.
alt: An empty road crosses quiet hills towards a faint golden glow on the horizon.
hidden: An hourglass (very small) beside the road.
translation: Retold in our own words, with short quotations from the World English Bible.
